info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Nosean Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Nosean Recliner Details Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage the specifications and details of the Nosean recliner product line. This API allows users to input, update, and manipulate detailed data related to recliner attributes, enhancing product visibility and customer engagement. Typical users include product managers and retailers who need to keep their inventory updated with accurate descriptions and specifications. Integration of this API streamlines the product catalog process and ensures that consumers have access to the latest product information.

post.summary: Create new details for a Nosean recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and submit new details related to a specific Nosean recliner. Ensure that all required information is included in the request body to successfully create these details.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for creating or updating a Nosean recliner. Ensure that all required fields are included and formatted correctly to process the request successfully.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested detail information.
